zh-CN.name: 外贸营销与业务套件
zh-CN.summary: 12岗位协作开展搜索/LinkedIn研究、内容、受控邮件社媒触达及外贸支持。需自备模型、渠道账号与数据许可，费用另计；缺依赖交付范围受限草稿。0.1.0受控试用，不承诺自主稳定性或获客效果。
zh-CN.description: 负责人、邮件、搜索地图、社媒研究、社媒运营、海关、广告及5个业务支持岗位，包含14项独立编写工作技能。按关键词、国家与客户角色研究企业，交付来源、未知项、内容草稿和授权范围内触达回执。共享身份核验、跨工具查询预算、停联、缺地址分流、未知不重发、入站方向及幂等恢复约定，附逐项模拟指令。LinkedIn、Facebook和系统邮件已有控制者辅助受控功能验证；Facebook公司关键词检索、TikTok/X、企业海关、真实广告、硬崩溃并发和无人值守仍待验证，不外推商业效果。支持用例涵盖尽调、单证、寻源、产品图及站点审阅，未继承第三方脚本测试结果。业务网页使用本地外置浏览器，已登录核身份复用，未登录及验证码由本人处理；邮件优先系统邮箱登录，也允许指定可信连接。需要用户模型及对应平台账号、权限、企业数据/素材许可，服务条款及额外费用自行承担；工具不包含服务授权或额度。依赖不可用时停止相关外部调用，提供范围受限草稿。安装后正常审阅团队规则、成员及共享工作目录，模型和真实业务数据不随包分发。首版0.1.0为受控试用，不保证全网企业穷尽、回复率或成交。

en-US.name: Foreign Trade Marketing and Operations Suite
en-US.summary: Twelve roles for search/LinkedIn research, content, controlled email/social outreach and trade support. Bring model services, accounts and data licenses; separate costs apply. Missing dependencies yield bounded drafts. Controlled pilot, with no autonomy or sales guarantee.
en-US.description: A lead, six marketing specialists and five trade-support specialists provide fourteen independently authored work skills. Research companies by keyword, country and customer role; return sources, unknowns, drafts and receipts for authorized actions. Shared conventions cover identity verification, cross-tool query budgets, stops, missing addresses, unknown outcomes, inbound direction and idempotent recovery, with stepwise simulation instructions. Prior controller-assisted controlled tests covered LinkedIn, Facebook and system mail. Facebook company keyword discovery, TikTok/X, enterprise customs, live ads, hard crashes/concurrency and unattended operation remain unverified; no commercial outcomes are claimed. Support covers due diligence, documents, sourcing, product images and website review without inheriting third-party script acceptance. Business websites use a local external browser; authenticated profiles are reused after identity checks, and humans handle login and challenges. Prefer system mail sign-in, or an explicitly selected trusted connection. Requires user-configured model services and applicable platform accounts, permissions, enterprise data and asset licenses, with separate terms and costs. Tools do not include service subscriptions or credits. Stop affected external calls when dependencies are unavailable and provide bounded drafts. Review team rules, roster and work-directory binding after installation. No model credentials or business records are bundled. Version 0.1.0 is a controlled pilot with no exhaustive discovery, response-rate or sales guarantee.
